sloka: अज्ञानात्तु हतो यस्मात् क्षत्रियेण त्वया मुनिः ।तस्मात्त्वाम् नाविशत्याशु ब्रह्महत्या नराधिप ॥२-६४-५६॥
transliteration: ajñānāttu hato yasmāt kṣatriyeṇa tvayā muniḥ ।tasmāttvām nāviśatyāśu brahmahatyā narādhipa ॥2-64-56॥

translations.english: 'Since you, O lord of men, you have killed an ascetic unaware, as kshatriya the sin of slaying a brahmin will not accrue to you immediately.
